$comment: Golden cases for recurrence. Expected values were computed with python-dateutil rrule and IANA tzdata, not by hand. Timezone is America/Chicago for every case. Note the UTC offsets: they are part of the assertion, because preserving wall-clock time across a DST boundary is the behavior being locked in.

policies.materialization: Exactly one open instance exists per series at any time.
policies.wall_clock: A recurring instant keeps its local wall-clock time across DST transitions. The UTC offset changes; the displayed time does not.
policies.nonexistent_local_time: If a generated local time does not exist because of a spring-forward gap, shift it forward by the length of the gap. 02:30 on 2026-03-08 becomes 03:30 CDT.
policies.ambiguous_local_time: If a generated local time occurs twice because of a fall-back overlap, take the first occurrence. 01:30 on 2026-11-01 resolves to 01:30 CDT (-05:00).
policies.bymonthday_31: RFC 5545 behavior: months without a 31st are skipped, not clamped. Use BYMONTHDAY=-1 for last-day-of-month.
policies.after_completion_month: In after_completion mode a monthly interval clamps to the last valid day. 31 Jan plus one month is 28 Feb.
policies.reopen: Reopening a completed task never modifies the series and never deletes an already-generated next instance.

fixed_mode.name: weekly across the end of DST
fixed_mode.note: Wall clock stays 09:00. The offset moves from -05:00 to -06:00. A naive implementation that adds 168 hours produces 08:00 on 2026-11-02 and fails here.

fixed_mode.name: monthly on the 31st skips short months
fixed_mode.note: February, April, June are skipped entirely. Do not clamp.

fixed_mode.name: yearly on Feb 29 lands only on leap years

catchup.name: skip rolls forward and logs the misses
catchup.note: Six missed occurrences produce six events of kind recurrence.missed and exactly one open task.

after_completion_mode.name: interval counts from completion, not from the rule
after_completion_mode.note: The next due is completion plus the interval. The previous due date is ignored. A date-only due stays date-only.

after_completion_mode.name: monthly from a month end clamps
completing early still moves the anchor
after_completion_mode.note: Completing eleven days early pulls the whole series eleven days earlier. That is the intended behavior of this mode. Do not add a rule that prevents it.

dst_edges.name: ambiguous local time takes the first pass
